units.normal_preservation: Keep the article exactly; retain P, area, and 20 square metres. No hold or correction.
units.citation_scope: S1 directly supports P’s area; do not transfer M’s installation dimensions to P.

units.citation_scope: The release attribution scopes to the first-device clause; the separate research-note attribution scopes to the second-device clause. Both are already correct.
